system.description:
You are able to draw upon The Force more often than less skilled users.

Prerequisite: None. Anyone can take Force Boon, including characters without Force Sensitivity and Droids.

Effect: You gain 2 additional Force Points per day. This also raises your Destiny Point cap, which equals your Force Points per day.

Special: You can take Force Boon only once.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Core Rulebook
